newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong mulls asset sale to repay debt.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong mulls asset sale to repay debt.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Motor Co Ltd, an affiliate of Ssangyong Group, is considering selling its building and real estate in southern Seoul to pay off its debt, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We are considering selling our building and land in southern Seoul," said spokesman Cho Min-jun.
"If we decide to sell, we expect to raise 70 to 80 billion won through the sale," he said.
Ssangyong Motor's net losses have risen due largely to higher financial costs on loans the company took out to expand production lines.
The automaker posted a net loss of 228.5 billion won in 1996, up from 126.2 billion won in 1995.
Ssangyong Motor put its total debt at 3.2 trillion won.
